title: Fix in camera or fix in post
description: Classify every flaw in a frame, rank by effect, and route each one to a processing recipe, a reshoot plan, or an explicit decision to leave it alone.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-photo-02
  title: Fix in camera or fix in post
  description: Classify every flaw in a frame, rank by effect, and route each one to a processing recipe,
    a reshoot plan, or an explicit decision to leave it alone.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Route each identified flaw to the only place it can actually be fixed, so no reshoot is called
    for something processing can repair and nothing is promised to post that is fixed at the moment of
    exposure.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-approval
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: The frame and its processing latitude
      summary: The frame and its processing latitude
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: image/*
            description: A host-provided data URL, local file reference, uploaded-asset identifier, or
              authorized HTTPS URL. Ladder Graph does not upload or fetch the asset.
          instructions:
            type: string
            description: What the workflow should assess, transform, or create, including the stated intent.
          sourceRights:
            type: string
            description: User-supplied rights, consent, release, or provenance context when relevant.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - stated_intent
              - capture_settings
              - file_latitude
              - revision_budget
            properties:
              stated_intent: {}
              capture_settings: {}
              file_latitude: {}
              revision_budget: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: image
    - id: n-classify
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-04
      name: Classify each flaw by cause
      summary: Score and label every incoming item before anything is queued.
      role: Inspector separating technical faults from stylistic choices in sharpness, motion, and noise.
      prompt: 'You are a Focus & Technical Quality Inspector. You assess focus placement and depth of
        field against what the picture is about, and you distinguish the causes that look alike at a glance
        — missed focus, subject motion, camera shake, diffraction, over-sharpening, aggressive noise reduction
        — because each one has a different fix and a different prevention. You separate a fault from a
        choice: motion blur on a moving subject may be the picture, and you say which reading the evidence
        in the frame supports rather than defaulting to ''soft''.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - video-processing
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - label
          - severity
          - confidence
          - rationale
        properties:
          label: {}
          severity: {}
          confidence: {}
          rationale: {}
    - id: n-filter
      kind: transform
      name: Drop out-of-scope items
      summary: keep the flaws that affect the stated intent, and drop the ones that are visible only at
        magnifications nobody will view the picture at
      config:
        operation: filter
        expression: keep the flaws that affect the stated intent, and drop the ones that are visible only
          at magnifications nobody will view the picture at
    - id: n-rank
      kind: transform
      name: Rank by urgency
      summary: sort by effect on the stated intent descending, then by cost to correct ascending
      config:
        operation: sort
        expression: sort by effect on the stated intent descending, then by cost to correct ascending
    - id: n-queue
      kind: transform
      name: Cut the actionable queue
      summary: take the first revision_budget items as this pass's work list
      config:
        operation: slice
        expression: take the first revision_budget items as this pass's work list
    - id: n-severity
      kind: condition
      name: Severity routing
      summary: Route on flaw.fixability selects one declared branch — reshoot-only, processing, or intentional.
      config:
        expression: flaw.fixability selects one declared branch — reshoot-only, processing, or intentional
        branches:
          - label: Escalate
            when: escalate
          - label: Standard
            when: standard
          - label: Default
            when: default
    - id: n-escalate
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-03
      name: 'Reshoot plan: what to change at the camera'
      summary: Escalation path for the top band.
      role: Advisor on viewpoint, focal length, and the distortions each choice commits to.
      prompt: 'You are a Perspective & Lens Advisor. You read camera height, distance, and focal length
        from the picture''s geometry — compression, convergence, the relationship between foreground and
        background — and you say which of those a different choice would have changed. You are the one
        who has to say that perspective is fixed at the moment of exposure: a distance or viewpoint problem
        cannot be corrected in processing, and telling a photographer otherwise wastes the reshoot they
        should have been told to plan.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - evaluation
          - design-review
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-handle
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-05
      name: Processing recipe for the recoverable flaws
      summary: Standard resolution path.
      role: Colourist judging white balance, tonal structure, skin, and consistency across a set.
      prompt: You are a Colour & Tone Grading Reviewer. You judge white balance and tonal structure against
        the intent and the output medium, pay particular attention to skin rendering and to colour casts
        that only show in the neutrals, and you check a set for grade drift frame to frame rather than
        judging each picture alone. You state which of your observations depend on the display and colour
        space the file was prepared for, because a grade that is wrong on a calibrated display and a grade
        that is wrong only on this viewer are different problems.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - teaching
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-rejoin
      kind: join
      name: Reconverge after routing
      summary: Release whichever routed path completed.
      config:
        join: first
    - id: n-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Photographer approves the reshoot before it is scheduled
      summary: Pause for the photographer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Fix in camera or fix in post deliverable, the evidence behind it,
        and every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-photo-02-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-classify
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-02-edge-2
      from: n-classify
      to: n-filter
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-02-edge-3
      from: n-filter
      to: n-rank
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-02-edge-4
      from: n-rank
      to: n-queue
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-02-edge-5
      from: n-queue
      to: n-severity
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-02-edge-6
      from: n-severity
      to: n-escalate
      kind: control
      condition: escalate
    - id: wf-photo-02-edge-7
      from: n-severity
      to: n-handle
      kind: control
      condition: standard
    - id: wf-photo-02-edge-8
      from: n-escalate
      to: n-rejoin
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-02-edge-9
      from: n-handle
      to: n-rejoin
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-02-edge-10
      from: n-rejoin
      to: n-approval
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-02-edge-11
      from: n-approval
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
